profile.headline: Software Engineer @ ECS | Python, Svelte, Microservices | Active Clearance
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with over 3 years of experience in a variety of tools. The last few years have seen me contributing to back-end services written in Python (with FastAPI), front-end projects using Svelte, and managing microservice application deployments within Kubernetes clusters. 

At home, I'm actively studying Go in my spare time to try and broaden my skillset. I am currently pursuing a degree in Software Development and Security at the University of Maryland Global Campus.

positions.title: Solutions Specialist/Python Developer
positions.description: I spent the majority of my tour in Hawaii developing python scripts used to automate processes and parse large quantities of data for customers. This work role helped me to develop my programming skillset and learn to communicate with a customer in order to satisfy customer requirements. While using Python, I focused on the use of libraries such as pandas, numpy, plotly, and matplotlib to automate rote tasks and assist in the analysis of data.
positions.insights: Pandas (Software), Collaborative Problem Solving and +3 skills

positions.title: Joint Cyber Analysis Course (JCAC)
positions.description: Completed the US Navy's Joint Cyber Analysis Course (JCAC) in order to qualify for my Job Role. JCAC is a 6 month course that introduces servicemembers to a number of important topics related to computers, network, security, and programming. Throughout this course, I learned topics such as basic programming, system architecture, discrete structures, the inner workings of Windows and Linux operating systems, and exploitation techniques. This course provided an introduction to, as well as some experience in, multiple high level concepts and technologies that have benefitted me throughout my career.
